templates.why_chosen: One of only 3 double-column layered figures in the corpus; a shared DRAM bus at the top feeds parallel engines below, tagged A-I.
templates.what_to_learn: At double column a layered hardware figure becomes bus-on-top with engines hanging below; lettered callouts (A-I) index the prose instead of ordering a flow.

templates.why_chosen: Canonical floorplan: a full-width DRAM bus feeds parallel engines below, a pink FC Detection Engine occupies its own vertical band between tracking and mapping engines, and letters A-I key every block to the text.
templates.what_to_learn: Draw one shared bus as a full-width bar at the top of the chip boundary, place a distinct control engine in its own vertical band between the two functional engines it coordinates, and letter every block (A-I) to key it to the prose instead of writing long labels in place.
